{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling the thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders, as they should not count toward revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
# This is critical because the channel was not randomly assigned
# The email campaign was targeted at loyal customers, who are more valuable
channel_segment_crosstab = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Output the crosstab
channel_segment_crosstab"}
